LATENCY TODAY: bar close, then the hourly lane at :07, then row PR CI + merge (~15-30 min), then a manager wake, then the system-action. Expect ~30-75 min from bar close to stop moved.

CANDIDATE DESIGNS to evaluate (pick by measured latency; keep every mandate gate in live_review_dispatch.py / approve_amend):
(a) A workflow on push to main touching comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl. It diffs the new rows and runs the live-review-apply action for each qualifying tighten_sl (mechanics match, route recommended/auto_applied). This removes the LLM hop after merge.
(b) A VM-side watcher. After each ict-git-sync pull, it runs live_review_dispatch.py for new qualifying rows, with idempotency per review_id via dispatch_state.json. This removes Actions queueing too.
(c) Cut the row-PR CI time: a fast-path guard subset for reviews.jsonl-only PRs.
(d) Move the review trigger from the hourly cron to bar-close events.

DONE WHEN: the first real tighten_sl goes from row merge to venue read-back with no human or manager step, and the latency is measured and stated on the row.

Tier 2: it touches the deploy/runtime apply path, so it needs one operator OK before merge.
